name: Path Finder
price: Subscription $29.95/year or $2.95/month, or license key from $32.95 (1 year updates), $55.95 (2 years), $122.95 (5 years); 30-day trial
summary: Long-running Finder replacement with dual pane, modules (Preview, Info, Terminal, Drop Stack), size browser, batch rename and folder sync. Good for power users who want many tools around a Finder-like browser.
where_it_wins: Modules: Preview, Info, Terminal, Drop Stack, Git, hex/text editor
Batch rename, secure delete, admin access
where_schnellbild_wins: Opens archives as folders (Path Finder only extracts)
Real image/video viewer with slideshow and full-size paging

free.note: $29.95/year or $2.95/month subscription, or license from $32.95 (1 year of updates); 30-day trial with all features

native_apple_silicon.note: Runs natively on Intel and Apple Silicon

no_account_no_tracking.note: No usage data; subscription requires sign-in (email/password) and periodic online check; license key alternative

dark_light_setting.note: Release notes only mention support for the system Dark Mode; no app-level appearance switch found in Settings articles, release notes or web search

thumbnail_grid.note: Icon View for images; no folder preview thumbnails

recursive_search.note: Find window (FileSearch and Spotlight modes) with many criteria

regex_search.note: Name 'matches pattern' (wildcards); regular expressions not documented

network_shares_fast.note: Improved preview performance on network volumes; no general speed claim

img_modern_formats.note: Preview module/Quick Look with macOS codecs; no dedicated viewer

img_raw.note: Via macOS; ARW preview added in 26.1.8

img_psd_exr.note: Would depend on macOS Quick Look; neither Cocoatech nor Apple docs name PSD/EXR. Searched help center, release notes, Apple Quick Look guide

img_svg_pdf.note: Preview module supports SVG and PDF

img_animated.note: Animated GIF plays in the macOS Quick Look window (GIF listed by Cocoatech; Apple: Quick Look plays animated GIFs); APNG/WebP not documented

keyboard_paging.note: Arrow keys while Quick Look or the Preview module is open

slideshow.note: No own slideshow; the macOS Quick Look window shows several selected items as a slideshow in full screen

slideshow_recursive.note: No such feature in the help center (all 50 articles), the features page or the release notes; Quick Look only shows the selected items

auto_enhance_view.note: No such feature in the help center (all 50 articles), the features page or the release notes

file_info_exif.note: Info panel shows dimensions, duration and macOS metadata; codecs/bitrate not documented

wrong_extension_note.note: No such feature in the help center (all 50 articles), the features page or the release notes

video_native.note: Preview module with media playback controls

video_mkv_avi_webm.note: WebM preview added; MKV/AVI not mentioned

photos_videos_one_grid.note: Icon View shows all file types

video_skim_arrows.note: Arrow keys move to the next file in Quick Look/Preview, not through the video

subtitles_embedded.note: Not mentioned by Cocoatech; whether the macOS Quick Look player offers a subtitle menu is not documented. Searched help center, release notes, Apple Quick Look guide

subtitles_external_files.note: Media plays only in the Preview module or the macOS Quick Look window; no player settings in the help center or release notes

audio_track_choice.note: Not mentioned by Cocoatech; track menu of the macOS Quick Look player not documented. Searched help center, release notes, Apple Quick Look guide

playback_speed.note: Media plays only in the Preview module or the macOS Quick Look window; no player settings in the help center or release notes

control_bar_movable.note: Media plays only in the Preview module or the macOS Quick Look window; no player settings in the help center or release notes

playlist.note: No such feature in the help center (all 50 articles), the features page or the release notes

saved_playlists.note: No such feature in the help center (all 50 articles), the features page or the release notes

pip.note: Media plays only in the Preview module or the macOS Quick Look window; no player settings in the help center or release notes

music_mode.note: Audio playback in Preview/Quick Look only

streaming_urls.note: No such feature in the help center (all 50 articles), the features page or the release notes

online_subtitles.note: No such feature in the help center (all 50 articles), the features page or the release notes

video_filters_enhance.note: Media plays only in the Preview module or the macOS Quick Look window; no player settings in the help center or release notes

quicklook_mkv_thumbnails.note: Uses the Quick Look generators installed on the Mac; adds none of its own (WebM preview added in-app)

archives_as_folders.note: Compress and extract only (ZIP, TAR, GZIP …); archives are not browsed like folders

comics_cbz_cbr.note: Archives are compressed/extracted only; no comic reader

split_archives.note: Archiving article lists ZIP, TAR, GZIP 'etc.' without split sets; release notes silent. Searched help center and release notes

manga_two_page.note: No such feature in the help center (all 50 articles), the features page or the release notes

move_copy.note: Drag and drop, Drop Stack, copy queues

dual_pane.note: Dual pane, but copy/move via ⌘C/⌘V/⌘X or drag; no F5/F6 defaults (shortcuts assignable)

undo_file_actions.note: Undo for move, copy and send-to-trash via menu or keystroke (introduced in Path Finder 4.5); not described in the current help center

image_editing.note: Built-in editors are text (Preview module, Text Editor) and hex only

library_catalog.note: Finder tags and color labels only

cloud_sync.note: Dropbox integration, Cloud Uploader, iCloud Drive

keyboard_first.note: Many shortcuts, but mouse-oriented Finder-style UI

shortcut_cheatsheet.note: Support article lists common defaults; no printable sheet

boss_key.note: No such feature in the help center (all 50 articles), the features page or the release notes

app_sandbox.note: Not in the Mac App Store; works with administrator privileges and Full Disk Access, which the App Sandbox does not allow

no_network.note: Subscription checks, update checks, cloud features

mac_app_store.note: Not in the Mac App Store; direct download
